Title: Create Linear workspace/team
Description: Set up Linear workspace/team for the homeschool project and invite required users.
Acceptance Criteria: Workspace exists; project exists; Kaecey and Alex can access if desired.

Title: Create Linear project and workflow
Description: Create Homeschool Platform MVP project with statuses: Backlog, Ready, In Progress, In Review, Done, Blocked.
Acceptance Criteria: Project exists; statuses match workflow; priorities are enabled.

Title: Connect GitHub to Linear
Description: Connect GitHub integration so issues can create branches and link PRs.
Acceptance Criteria: GitHub integration works; test issue links to test branch or PR.

Title: Import initial backlog CSV
Description: Import this CSV into Linear and verify labels, priorities, and descriptions are readable.
Acceptance Criteria: All imported issues appear; bad formatting is fixed; duplicates are removed.

Title: Create agent rules file
Description: Add AGENTS.md or equivalent project rules so AI agents know to use Linear and acceptance criteria.
Acceptance Criteria: Rules file exists; Linear workflow is documented; branch and PR rules are included.

Title: Choose product name and positioning
Description: Decide app/site name and whether messaging is faith-forward, neutral homeschool, or both.
Acceptance Criteria: Name options are reviewed; one direction is chosen; homepage copy can begin.

Title: Create web/backend repository
Description: Create or select repo for homeschool web app and backend.
Acceptance Criteria: Repo exists; README explains stack; local dev can start.

Title: Choose app architecture
Description: Decide Next.js backend plus Android native, or shared React Native path.
Acceptance Criteria: Decision is documented with tradeoffs; downstream app tasks use chosen stack.

Title: Define database schema v1
Description: Design schema for users, families, children, grades, subjects, units, lessons, assignments, scores, and progress events.
Acceptance Criteria: Schema covers MVP objects; migrations run locally; seed data can reference curriculum outlines.

Title: Normalize LIFEPAC source data
Description: Convert existing LIFEPAC JSON/outlines into clean curriculum import format.
Acceptance Criteria: Grades 1-12, subjects, units, and outline sections parse without errors.

Title: Build curriculum importer
Description: Create script/import job to load normalized LIFEPAC data into database.
Acceptance Criteria: Importer can reset and seed curriculum; logs skipped or malformed rows.

Title: Create curriculum data licensing notes
Description: Document what data is public index data and what cannot be copied from paid workbooks.
Acceptance Criteria: README or docs clarify allowed source data and content boundaries.

Title: Build curriculum browser API
Description: Expose grade, subject, unit, and lesson outline endpoints.
Acceptance Criteria: API returns curriculum tree; endpoints are protected where needed; tests cover core responses.

Title: Build curriculum browser web page
Description: Create web page to browse grades, subjects, units, and outline sections.
Acceptance Criteria: User can select grade and subject; units display; loading and empty states exist.

Title: Create curriculum admin review screen
Description: Admin can see imported curriculum gaps, missing fields, and edit metadata.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin list shows gaps; metadata can be edited; changes persist.

Title: Create auth foundation
Description: Implement parent login/signup with selected auth provider.
Acceptance Criteria: Parent can sign up, log in, log out; protected routes block anonymous users.

Title: Create family and child profile model
Description: Parents can create family account and child profiles.
Acceptance Criteria: Parent can add/edit/archive child; child belongs to parent family.

Title: Create parent dashboard shell
Description: Build parent dashboard layout with child cards and progress placeholders.
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard loads for parent; child cards display; empty state prompts adding a child.

Title: Assign grade and subjects to child
Description: Parent can assign a grade level and active subjects to a child.
Acceptance Criteria: Assignments save; student dashboard reflects assigned subjects.

Title: Create assignment generation logic
Description: Generate daily or weekly assignments from grade/subject/unit pacing.
Acceptance Criteria: Parent can create a plan; system creates assignments; missed work is handled predictably.

Title: Build parent progress report
Description: Show completion, scores, and pacing by child, subject, and unit.
Acceptance Criteria: Parent sees percent complete, recent scores, and behind/on-track status.

Title: Add struggle alerts
Description: Flag repeated low scores, missed work, or stalled lessons for parent review.
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard flags clear issues; parent can dismiss or review details.

Title: Add weekly summary export
Description: Parent can export or print a weekly progress summary.
Acceptance Criteria: Summary includes child, subjects, completed work, scores, and notes.

Title: Create student login/access flow
Description: Define how children access their dashboard without full parent permissions.
Acceptance Criteria: Child can access assigned work; child cannot access parent/admin pages.

Title: Build student dashboard shell
Description: Student sees today's work, progress, and continue button.
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard shows assigned subjects and next lesson; empty state is friendly.

Title: Build lesson player shell
Description: Student can open a lesson outline with instructions/content placeholders.
Acceptance Criteria: Lesson loads from curriculum; complete button records progress.

Title: Build practice activity shell
Description: Create reusable activity component for multiple choice, short answer, and completion tasks.
Acceptance Criteria: Activity can render at least one question type; answers can be saved.

Title: Build quiz/test shell
Description: Create quiz/test flow with scoring and review states.
Acceptance Criteria: Student can submit quiz; score is recorded; parent can see result.

Title: Track progress events
Description: Record lesson start, completion, quiz score, and assignment completion events.
Acceptance Criteria: Events persist; reports use event data; duplicate completions are handled.

Title: Create web design system
Description: Define colors, typography, buttons, cards, forms, empty states, and mobile breakpoints.
Acceptance Criteria: Reusable components exist; main dashboard pages use them.

Title: Build public marketing homepage
Description: Create website homepage explaining homeschool platform and parent/student benefits.
Acceptance Criteria: Homepage has clear CTA, feature sections, and responsive layout.

Title: Create Android app repo or module
Description: Create Android project based on chosen architecture.
Acceptance Criteria: App builds locally or in CI; README explains setup.

Title: Android auth flow
Description: Android app supports login and session persistence.
Acceptance Criteria: Parent/student can log in; token/session survives app restart.

Title: Android student dashboard
Description: Build Android student dashboard with today's work and continue action.
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard loads real assignments; loading/error states exist.

Title: Android lesson player
Description: Build Android lesson shell that reads same curriculum API.
Acceptance Criteria: Lesson opens; complete action syncs to backend.

Title: Android quiz/test shell
Description: Build Android quiz/test flow with scoring sync.
Acceptance Criteria: Student submits quiz; score appears in parent web dashboard.

Title: Android parent quick view
Description: Parent can see child progress summary in Android app.
Acceptance Criteria: Parent sees children, completion, and recent scores.

Title: Set up CI for web/backend
Description: Run lint, typecheck, tests, and build on PRs.
Acceptance Criteria: CI blocks broken builds; README includes status.

Title: Set up CI for Android
Description: Run Android build/test on PRs or pushes.
Acceptance Criteria: CI produces build artifact or verifies app compiles.

Title: Add logging and error monitoring
Description: Add basic server/client logging and error capture.
Acceptance Criteria: Errors are visible; user-facing failures include useful messages.

Title: Create QA checklist
Description: Define manual QA checklist for parent, student, curriculum, and Android flows.
Acceptance Criteria: Checklist exists; beta cannot ship until checklist passes.

Title: Prepare beta deployment
Description: Deploy web/backend to selected host and configure database/env vars.
Acceptance Criteria: Beta URL is live; smoke tests pass; database migrations run.

Title: Prepare Android beta distribution
Description: Set up internal Android beta distribution path.
Acceptance Criteria: Kaecey can install a beta build; update process is documented.

Title: Collect beta feedback
Description: Add simple feedback capture from parent/student users.
Acceptance Criteria: Feedback can be submitted; items appear in admin or tracked inbox.

Title: Plan iOS phase
Description: Create iOS project plan after Android MVP validates core UX.
Acceptance Criteria: iOS scope and architecture decision are documented.
